user_query: I want to organize a team-building event for my company. Find me a spacious venue in San Francisco that can accommodate 100 people. Additionally, provide a list of available currency quotes for international travel and a random Chuck Norris joke to lighten the mood.

TaskList.description: Search for available venues in San Francisco that can accommodate at least 100 people.
Retrieve a list of current currency quotes relevant for international travel.
Get a random Chuck Norris joke to lighten the mood for the event.
